All values are static or derived from declared variables with no obfuscation.

The checksums are present and not skipped, but even if they were, that would not affect the safety of this gate. No data exfiltration, dynamic code evaluation, or suspicious network operations occur during sourcing. The file adheres to standard AUR packaging practices.
